Chapter 6342: All Running

Chapter 6342: All Running

The alloy tree commanded the others to break the barriers and continued the exodus. Once they made it, they automatically found spots to plant themselves.

They scattered all around the peak, making it rather difficult to gather them once more. Goldclad and Lostmetal stood still, witless. Their prized possessions ran away from Lost Peak like refugees seeking haven.

Next came explosions and lights from Centurial Peak. One particular stood out amidst the radiance, emitting a temporal presence.

Just looking at it gave spectators a feeling of cycles and reincarnation. Both regular disciples and masters thought they were being dragged into this cycle.

“Reborn tree!” Characters such as Crimson Virtue and Solar Monarch couldn’t believe it.

This was the most precious tree in Desolate Frontier and perhaps the rarest. Rumor has it Centurial Peak was built with it as the foundation. Most importantly, it played a pivotal role in the legacy passing of the Chen.

One legend stated First-gen Chen found a dao of reincarnation through the tree, allowing him to use something akin to “enlightenment” to pass everything including accumulated power, grand dao, and even memories. This alone spoke of how crucial the tree was for their branch.

“No!” The ancient voice bellowed.

“Boom!” A palm descended with a suppressive force engulfing Desolate Frontier.

Those on the same level as Solar Monarch and Crimson Virtue still became frozen. This was the power of Tenth-gen Chen.

Unfortunately, it couldn’t stop the reborn tree from leading the exodus away from Centurial Peak.

“Rumble!” The whole region of Centurial became affected, losing its precious trees.

“Not like this!” The members of Centurial Peak couldn’t do anything about it.

Ten-realm Emperor who was freed also attempted to stop the reborn tree. This was proven futile.

The trees started digging and planted themselves as if terrible calamities were happening to Lost and Centurial Peak.

Now they have lost the symbiotic relationship. Although it took a lot of effort to plant and nourish the trees, the latter eventually released spirit energy back to the land. Their medicinal properties also helped calm the mind and improve one’s cultivation power reserve.

The two peaks became gray and colorless with the trees and flowers gone, no longer brimming with spirit energy and life force.

Others could only watch in silence. This was their first time seeing something so magical. They were strong but still had a hard time controlling these rare trees. It took hard work and resources to keep the trees planted properly.

Now, Li Qiye only said one thing and the trees all left their habitat without any hesitation, abandoning their original owners.

The Chen spent eras nourishing the reborn tree so that it would be firmly rooted in Centurial Peak. It only took a few words for it to abandon the clan.

Now, it became apparent that Li Qiye was showing them respect and giving them a chance to offer the trees. Otherwise, just one command and all the trees in Desolate Frontier would have come running.

Solar Monarch became drenched in sweat. If he hadn’t changed his mind and only offered the two fire-essence trees, his peak might have suffered the same consequence.

Alch-deer and Huntblade were speechless, finally appreciating Li Qiye’s intent when telling them to deliver the message first.
